stories.headline: Iran fires drones at U.S. radar in Bahrain
stories.source: Just Security Early Edition, 17 Nov 2026; CNN
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they hit the radar at Sheikh Isa base; Bahrain says it intercepted the attack, with no casualties. U.S. intelligence also warns Iran is plotting a "dirty bomb" or chemical attack on Trump officials in Washington.

stories.headline: Ukraine cripples Crimea bridge; Russia hits Kyiv bridges
stories.source: Just Security Early Edition, 17 Nov 2026; Zark News
stories.summary: Ukraine severely damages the bridge linking Russia to Crimea. Russian missiles hit Kyiv's North and South bridges, cutting heat, water and power.

stories.headline: Trump flies to Asia for nuclear talks with Xi and Putin
stories.source: FeedCast Daily Brief, 17 Nov 2026; Open Chronicle
stories.summary: Trump heads to APEC in Shenzhen for a 19 Nov trilateral with Xi Jinping and Putin, focused on nuclear risks, sanctions and Ukraine.

stories.headline: Japan scrambles jets as Russian planes breach its airspace
stories.source: Just Security Early Edition, 17 Nov 2026; Asas Press
stories.summary: Two suspected Russian aircraft violated Japanese airspace early on Tuesday. Tokyo launched fighter jets and lodged a strong protest with Moscow.

stories.headline: West presses Israel to open Gaza aid crossings
stories.source: Asas Press World News Digest, 17 Nov 2026; Just Security
stories.summary: UK, Australia, Canada and Italy urge Israel to open Gaza to rapid humanitarian aid. The UK sanctions eight firms building West Bank settlements.

stories.headline: Depardieu drops appeal; assault conviction now final
stories.summary: Depardieu, 77, drops his appeal as the Paris trial was due to open, accepting an 18-month suspended sentence for assaulting two women on a film set.

stories.headline: Pentagon fails its ninth straight audit
stories.source: Zark News, 17 Nov 2026; Reuters; Washington Examiner
stories.summary: Auditors again cannot verify books covering $4.8 trillion in assets, even as the administration seeks a record $1.5 trillion defence budget.
